title: Vanilla Panna Cotta
blurb: A silky Italian set cream dessert with a gentle vanilla flavour, chilled until just firm enough to wobble on the plate.
steps: Pour three tablespoons of the milk into a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatine over the surface and leave to soften for five minutes.
Put the cream, remaining milk and sweetener in a saucepan and warm gently over a low heat, stirring occasionally, until it just begins to steam but does not boil.
Remove from the heat and add the softened gelatine, stirring until it dissolves completely into the warm cream.
Stir in the vanilla extract, then pour the mixture through a fine sieve into a jug.
Divide the mixture between six small ramekins or moulds, then cover each with cling film and refrigerate for at least three hours until set.
To serve, dip the base of each mould briefly in warm water and turn out onto a plate, or serve directly in the ramekins.
